patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: The gym showers, I'm certain of it. It's itchy and peeling between my toes and I have run out of ideas that come in a tube.
presentation.triageNote: 26-year-old male with three weeks of itching and scaling between the toes, without cellulitis or ulceration.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this chronic localized fungal foot rash requires examination and medication but no counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has interdigital itching and scaling without cellulitis or ulceration.
clinical.acuityReason: This chronic localized fungal foot rash requires examination and medication but no counted emergency resource.
teachingPoints: No resources needed: a look and a prescription. Worth checking the toenails and web spaces, because fissures there are a common doorway for cellulitis.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Topical treatment, foot hygiene, and return guidance would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a black 26-year-old man in gym clothes with both shoes off and bare feet, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting with one ankle resting on the opposite knee, inspecting between his own toes
signs: dry flaking skin between the toes
gym bag and trainers on the floor
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a black 26-year-old man in gym clothes with both shoes off and bare feet, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with one ankle resting on the opposite knee, inspecting between his own toes. Expression: resigned and mildly disgusted. Clearly visible: dry flaking skin between the toes; gym bag and trainers on the floor. Overall: entirely well. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
